questions: Have you had difficulty looking downward, such as when reading, walking downstairs, or eating?
Did these eye-movement problems begin suddenly?
Have they progressively worsened over time?
Have you had repeated falls, especially early in the course of your illness?
Do you feel unusually stiff or slow in your movements?
Have you had difficulty initiating walking or experienced episodes in which your feet feel stuck to the floor?
Have you developed problems with speech or swallowing?
Have you or others noticed changes in your personality, judgment, motivation, or thinking?
Do you have a prominent tremor when your hands are at rest?
Have you experienced vivid dream enactment, such as shouting or moving violently during sleep?
Have you had hallucinations while awake?
Have you had urinary urgency or incontinence?
Have you had dizziness on standing, constipation, erectile dysfunction, or other prominent autonomic symptoms?
Have you ever had a stroke, significant head injury, brain infection, or brain tumor?
Have you taken antipsychotic medications, metoclopramide, prochlorperazine, or other dopamine-blocking drugs?
Do any close relatives have a similar movement or eye-movement disorder?
